subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a public persisted cron, Gateway, CLI, UI, hook, and plugin SDK status, or should yielded-parent waiting remain an internal lifecycle state?
rationale: Both choices can fix premature completion, but only maintainers can establish the long-term public status contract and acceptable upgrade behavior for external clients and stored run history.

options.title: Adopt the public status
options.body: Keep `deferred`, document it as a supported contract, and require exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, best-effort delivery, final synthesis, and Discord settlement proof before merge.

options.title: Keep waiting internal
options.body: Preserve parent and task liveness internally while mapping public cron surfaces to an existing compatible state until a versioned status extension is designed.

options.title: Split the lifecycle work
options.body: Land a narrower internal parent-reconciliation fix first and defer the public status and Discord projection changes to separately reviewed follow-ups.

recommendation.title: Adopt the public status
recommendation.body: Keep `deferred`, document it as a supported contract, and require exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, best-effort delivery, final synthesis, and Discord settlement proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this person to the original yield semantics and recent parent completion and resume behavior.
